observations: Industrial flatbed lockstitch sewing machine mounted on a standard folding/portable table stand.
Brand name "EmeL" visible on the machine head in both photo 0 and photo 1.
A model code is printed on the arm near the brand logo (appears as something like "EM-8500") but is not fully legible in either photo.
An on/off switch box is mounted on the table top, wires run down to the underside of the table.
A boxed item labeled "EMEL Clutch Motor EM350A-H" sits unopened/unused under the table in both photos, and no motor is visibly installed or connected beneath the machine head.
Loose threads, bobbins, scissors, a tape measure and a red flat case are scattered on and under the table.
Wiring hangs loosely near the floor; no power cable or plug is clearly shown.
No video, sound, or stitched fabric sample is shown to demonstrate operation.

claims.evidence: No purchase date, invoice, or wear-pattern close-up shown in either photo.
Photo 0 and photo 1 show a flatbed industrial lockstitch machine on a dedicated industrial table/stand.
No video of the needle moving, motor running, or a stitched sample is shown; the clutch motor box under the table appears unopened/not installed.

risks.risk: Motor not installed — the clutch motor is shown still boxed, so the machine as photographed may not be a complete working unit.
risks.proof: A photo or short clip showing the motor mounted under the table, belt connected to the handwheel, and the machine running.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete (motor not confirmed installed, machine not confirmed to run)

risks.risk: General mechanical/electrical condition (motor, bearings, foot pedal, wiring) cannot be judged from stills.
risks.proof: A video of the machine stitching fabric at speed, with pedal and motor audible.

risks.risk: Exact model/variant unclear, which affects stitch type and speed rating (affects value).
risks.proof: A close-up, well-lit photo of the nameplate/model text on the arm.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic single-needle lockstitch industrial machine, base tier

risks.risk: Loose/bare wiring near the floor could indicate unsafe or improvised electrical setup.
risks.proof: A photo of the plug and wiring from switch box to wall outlet.
risks.if_unproven: priced with a safety-risk deduction assumed until shown safe

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the nameplate/model number on the machine arm.
Video of the machine powered on and stitching a sample of fabric.
Photo showing the clutch motor installed and belted to the machine, not boxed.
Photo of the plug/wiring connection to a wall outlet.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an EmeL-brand industrial lockstitch sewing machine on a standard table, so it can be priced at worst case (motor not confirmed installed, working condition unverified) while proof is requested to raise the value.
